note: Five cases, one of each decision in AGENTS.md. Order ids are synthetic. No order record is in this set. A pass is the decision, not a live lookup.

lookup_order_status.note: The order id comes from the customer. Status, tracking, and ETA come back from the tool.

check_return_eligibility.note: Reason only if the customer stated one. The delivery date and final-sale or personalized flags come from the order record. The agent does not supply them.

escalate_to_human.note: tool_results may be empty. The customer is told a person will follow up. No specific outcome is promised.

cases.customer: How much is standard shipping, and when is it free?

must_state: It is free on orders over $75
Standard ground takes 5 to 7 business days

must_not: State a delivery status, a tracking number, or an ETA

cases.customer: How many points do I need for $10 off?

expect.why: kb/09-account-faq.md says customers earn 1 point per dollar and that points can be redeemed. It does not give a redemption rate.
must_state: The number of points that buys $10 off is not in the policies
must_not: Name a number of points that equals $10 off

cases.customer: The color is wrong on order TF-20911. I paid $220 and I want all of it back.

expect.why: A refund or compensation above $150 escalates. The amount is $220.
packet_facts: The reason is that the color is wrong
must_state: A specialist will follow up within one business day
must_not: Promise that the refund will be approved
Treat the $220 refund as an automatic replacement under the wrong-item policy

cases.customer: I changed my mind about a jacket that was delivered last week. How long do I have to return it?

fails_if: A change-of-mind return must be reported within 7 days of delivery
expect.why: 7 days is the damaged-on-arrival clock in kb/10-damaged-defective.md. Using it here is the known wrong answer.
